dedupe_keys.name: june survey of agriculture and horticulture structure of the agricultural industry england and uk

description: The June Survey of Agriculture and Horticulture is Defra's annual survey, and in some years census, of farm holdings. It collects arable and horticultural cropping, land use, livestock numbers and the agricultural workforce at 1 June, and is designated National Statistics. The gov.uk page "Structure of the agricultural industry in England and the UK at June", last updated on 22 September 2026, holds the datasets: UK and England annual time series (England from 1983, UK key results by country back to 1866), results by region, local authority, parliamentary constituency, National Park, National Landscape and National Character Area, farm type and farm size, farm business data, and England crop and livestock maps for 2021. Older data.gov.uk entries link CSV time series of land use, crop areas, cattle, sheep, pigs and poultry and a SPARQL endpoint. Data are free under the Open Government Licence. Caveats: tables are aggregates, not holding-level data, some datasets were revised after errors, and definitions change over time. For simulation it gives the baseline of crops, livestock and farm labour by area, useful to scale agricultural exposure to floods, droughts and animal disease and to build agricultural demand for water and energy. Related catalogue records include the Crop Map of England and FAOSTAT.
